profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Passionate about web development and all that is necessary with delivering  software of high value.  Have worked on responsive, multi-channel,  complex applications that successfully deployed to serve from thousands to millions of users. 

I consider myself a lifetime student and the ever-changing field of software development (especially at the frontend) fits well within that philosophy.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Developing React application projected to impact 5-10% of all Turbotax users.

The technical stack includes React, Redux,  Redux Saga, ES6/JSX, Styled Components, Webpack, Jenkins, and Splunk for logging.

positions.title: Senior Front-end Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Senior Front-end Developer
positions.description:
Worked as a full stack developer contractor for Bank of America.  My role involved building common components, helping our scrum team migrate to a new front-end framework, and to communicate with design and architecture teams. 

* Time is dedicated to 80% coding and 20% software design. 
* Technology stack includes: Java, Spring MVC, NodeJS, Javascript (ES6), SCSS, and Handlebars templating.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Roles involved working with an onshore/offshore model leveraging Agile methodologies. Front-end development of a large and complex Angular SPA. 

* Responsible for leading scrum team.
* Hands on coding 50-60%.
* Worked with onsite architecture team to solve challenging technical problems across the project.
* Received a promotion to Associate Manager within a year.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Floral software logistics company that provided a SaaS (Software as a Service) solution to flower importers across the globe. My responsibilities included working as a Java Developer working within an Agile Scrum enviroment. Used tools such as IntelliJ IDEA, Git, and Maven to develop robust and scalable software.

positions.title: E-Commerce Consultant
positions.description:
Worked on an enterprise E-Commerce solution for Talley, Inc. based out of Los Angeles, California.  Utilizing low-dependency solutions I was able to provide solutions in a rapid and efficient manner.  These solutions included working directly with both internal and external users to improve or add prefered funcionality. 
Development took place using Eclise, Java, and SVN as source control. Front-End languaged included CSS, HTML, and JavaScript (with AJAX). 
This position also included implementing SEO best practices learned and evolved from an earlier SEO specialists work experience.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description: Developed solutions for SEO Analytics software utilized by Fortune 500 companies.  Development took place in Eclipse using JSTL, Java, and the Spring framework.  Duties included working directly with MySQL (modifying the Data Model as needed), SVN, Search Engine APIs, and working directly with software architects find best-fit solutions.
